summary: ```markdown # Introduction to the New Features of CLO 7.1 Hello everyone, I am Stella from Cloud Shanghai. Today, I and my colleague Familia will introduce the new features of version 7.1. This time, our new features are divided into 8 parts: the main updates, 3D function, 2D function, virtual model, process details, rendering, text editor, and other files. ## Main Update Content ### Seamless Text Editor The first update content is the seamless text editor. This update has added the seamless text editor, allowing you to use a scanned image to generate continuous text in all directions. You can also check the effect in the 3D window. There are two modes: automatic mode and manual mode. #### How to Use the Seamless Text Editor 1. Go to the object window and find the object. 2. On the right side, you can see that a plus button has been added. Hover over it to create the seamless text editor. 3. Open the text editor. The window of the text editor will appear in the 2D window. ##### Structure of the Text Editor Window - The text editor is divided into two windows: - The upper part is the editing window of the object text area. - The lower part is the preview window of the result. Press the button at the bottom left to open the original text. You can see the original text image in the top editing window. The scroll wheel can be used to adjust the size of the text. At the top, you can see the size and resolution of the sample. The maximum size supported is 9999 pixels by 9999 pixels. If the original image exceeds this value, it will be automatically reduced to 9999 pixels. Ensure the size of the original image is smaller than the upper limit. In the upper left, you can see the material ball. Click to switch to check. The system will automatically detect the found image and import it. Pictures that need to be imported must use the same name as the original text. The system detects these pictures using English underscores and corresponding backslashes. For example, the backslash of the found image is due to the underscore Normal or NRM. ### Automatic Mode In the automatic mode, select the physical area and find the smallest area where the tree pattern repeats. When choosing, it should be larger than this area. Press the left mouse button to drag and select. The selected area should be larger than 200x200 pixels. After selection, small blue grids will appear within the frame selection range. This represents the single cycle range selected after automatic analysis. In the window below, the results of the automatic analysis of the selected area will be displayed. The scroll mouse wheel can enlarge and shrink the tree pattern. The grid button in the window helps identify the original location of the area through the line. You can check the clothing effect in the 3D window. If you want to adjust the area, you can drag and select again. In the lower right corner of the selected area, you can see the icon of the automatic mode, along with its description at the top of the icon. The selected area will automatically adjust to the best result. In automatic mode, you can set the tree type and average option in the upper right corner. Choosing the tree type helps achieve a more accurate analysis. There are three tree types: - **Pure Color**: Refers to the pure color of the tree without a pattern. - **Duplicate**: Refers to the tree pattern with a rule. - **Random**: Refers to the tree pattern without a rule. Adjusting the average value can help average the brightness differences caused by the fold marks in the tree. The smooth button on the far right can even out the image if the original image is not scanned evenly. After using the smooth function, the image will be evenly matched. ### Manual Mode Now, let's introduce the manual mode. When the part of the repetition of the text is relatively clear, you can use the manual mode to choose the text area. This is similar to the peek-and-seek function in Photoshop. Left-click to drag the frame to select the smallest circle of this pattern. It is still in automatic mode by default. You can click the button at the bottom right of the selected area to change the mode to manual mode. The manual mode is represented by a small hand-shaped icon. After switching to manual mode, you need to re-adjust the selected area. The preview window will update the new selection range and generate four consecutive repetition effects. After editing the text, click the save button at the bottom to save. If it matches multiple texts, you can click on the selection in the preview window to save multiple texts at once. Once the selection is complete, you can enter the name of the file and click save. If you want to use the completed image for the object immediately, you can click on "Apply" at the bottom and close it. The texture will then be applied to the selected object, and the texture generator will be turned off. ### Automatic 3D Arrangement In the new version of 7.1, we added automatic 3D arrangement, which helps arrange the panels around the model quickly. First, we need to set the panel to a symmetrical state for accuracy. After setting it up, in the 3D window toolbar, in the lower left corner, find the automatic 3D arrangement button. Clicking it will pop up a dynamic frame, and the panel will be arranged in 3D according to accuracy. This function is based on learning from a large number of panel data. Besides using the 3D tool, it can also help make the panel 3D, which is useful for more accurate arrangements. The panels arranged in each step are divided by color and transparency. To check the arrangement results of each step, you can use the back and forth buttons. After confirming the automatic arrangement, you can manually adjust the panel positions as necessary. ## Automatically Convert to Action This function can convert action files from external platforms to action files of Cloud. First, select the virtual model in the main menu at the top, and then select "Automatically Convert to Action." This will enter animation mode. In the window that pops up, select the gender of the module to be converted. Then, click on the file folder button at the bottom to open the FBX file that has been downloaded. Ensure the path name remains in full English, and then click convert. After the conversion is successful, a pop-up window will appear. You can click save or close it first. Play the preview in animation mode to confirm there are no errors before saving the file as a link to the action. The default saved path is under the virtual model file in the library, with the file format being mpn. Name this file "work" and then save. Click confirm. In 7.1, all action and posture files can be integrated into all Cloud models. Now let's open a model and double-click to select the action file in the mpn format that has just been saved. Click confirm to play the action effect. Similarly, the posture file can also be integrated. Now let's go back to simulation mode. Open a model and then open the virtual model file in the library window. Open the male model v2 file folder and select the posture. Use the male model v207 pose as an example. The male model posture can be integrated into the female model. Click confirm. ### Improvements in the Virtual Model Editor The virtual model editor has significantly improved in this version. Now, when you open a virtual model, you will find the virtual model editor in the upper left corner of the menu bar. The window of the virtual model editor is now positioned in the 2D window, making it more convenient to adjust the model's body shape. There are now three versions of the model editor: Full Body, Body Shape, and Details. Compared to the previous version, the body shape version has been added, and the UI interface of the detail panel has been optimized. The upper body, lower body, and other data are now categorized for more intuitive and clear editing. At the top, you can change the preset size of different standards. The document reflects the size of the virtual model in our virtual window. You can make changes directly on this side. The three buttons at the back are reset, open, and save. Clicking the reset button will return to the default size. In the full body section, this update increases the weight option in the width column. By entering the model's weight data, you can see the model's body shape change objectively. For example, changing the weight from 50 kg to 60 kg will adjust the body shape accordingly. In the details section, besides the original basic and advanced options, we added a simple option. When selecting weight in the width column, it will automatically switch to the simple option. If you know the model's three-dimensional data, you can enter it here, while other data can be automatically calculated. ### Improvements in Clothing and Components In this update, the clothing roll function is added to assist in creating sleeves, collars, and other clothing parts. For example, to roll up a sleeve, previously, you would use the addition of the internal line and folding arrangement tool, which was difficult to achieve. Now, with the new folding function, you can quickly create the desired rolling effect. To roll the sleeve, use the edit sheet tool, click on the outside line of the roll, and right-click. If the roll position comprises multiple sheets, press the Shift key to select multiple edges, and then right-click to select the roll in the menu bar. Enter the number and distance of the roll you want, setting the
